verdict.rationale: Fastmail has its own help article titled "Templates", which shows a first-party saved-template feature for composing. The pack contains only the article title, so how templates are inserted, and whether they support variables or attachments, is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence of how templates are inserted into replies, variable/placeholder support, attachment support in templates, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can insert saved snippets or templates — with variables and attachments — instead of retyping the same reply
